component.name: Tuna
component.summary: Song information plugin for OBS Studio

description.p: Tuna fetches information about the currently playing song and makes it available in OBS Studio as text, cover art, a progress bar or a browser widget.
Supported sources include Spotify, MPD, VLC, last.fm, Icecast, window titles, web browsers through a user script and any player that implements MPRIS.

screenshot.caption: Tuna showing the current song in OBS Studio
